messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: unusual burst of service tokens from svc-auth-proxy observed. 600 auth attempts in 6m, ~40% failed 401s then succeeded. Possible replay or token re-use. Auto-created incident P1-3075. See telemetry -> https://internal.redwood/telemetry/alerts/3075002222

Sara Chen: saw the same alert. starting runbook check. tagging @Ops Oncall. any rate-limit triggers?

Ops Oncall: I'm on it. pulling recent proxy logs and live sessions. can someone confirm whether this is internal CI traffic or customer traffic?

Jamal Ortiz: running a query now. early look: requests come from ~25 unique IPs across two AWS regions, all to /v1/auth/session and /v1/generate. agent header shows svc/connector-v2 in most.

Eli Novak: copying sample logs for pattern: 
```
# sample (anonymized)
ts=2026-03-15T02:03:12Z method=POST path=/v1/auth/session src=54.210.33.12 svc=connector-v2 token_id=tok_3fA9... resp=200
ts=2026-03-15T02:03:13Z method=POST path=/v1/generate src=54.210.33.12 svc=connector-v2 user_id=acct_9d resp=200
```
Looks like session token used across multiple sessions quickly.

Sara Chen: that token pattern (tok_3fA9...) maps to a long-lived service token we issued to partner integration 'BlueTrack' in Jan. Jamal, can you confirm?

Jamal Ortiz: confirmed. token_id prefix matches BlueTrack. Rotating it will affect integrations.

Eli Novak: suggestion: create emergency short-lived deny rule for outbound traffic to the set of suspicious IPs and put BlueTrack integration into a limited fallback mode while we rotate.

Ops Oncall: can do IP block in WAF and route to 503 for 5m windows. Will apply block lists and monitor. Doing now.

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted: WAF block-list update -> ruleset-3075 (initiated by Ops Oncall).

sec-bot: note: BlueTrack token has access to dedicated model endpoints for embeddings and generate. Recommend key rotation + revoke existing service token, then issue a new token with tightened scopes. Also confirm any forwarded logs that might contain the token.

Sara Chen: good call. Jamal, get a list of all tokens issued to BlueTrack and their scopes. We will schedule rotation for the main service token and coordinate with partner.

Jamal Ortiz: pulling token inventory. Found 1 primary svc token (tok_3fA9...), 2 test tokens, and an org-level api key used by their CI. Also see repeated requests from a staging account that looks like internal testing.

Eli Novak: we need immediate containment. Plan: 1) block suspicious IPs (Ops Oncall) 2) rotate primary token (Sara & Jamal) 3) revoke any leaked test tokens 4) notify partner and agree maintenance window 5) monitor for replays. Who's owning customer comms?

Sara Chen: I'll own partner comms (message + guided rotation). Jamal + Ops Oncall handle rotation and revocation. Eli will keep monitoring signals and run eval prompts against canary endpoint to detect regressions.

Ops Oncall: WAF blocks applied to list (54.210.33.0/24, 18.196.0.0/24) and rate-limit lowered on /v1/auth/session -> 10r/m. Observing initial drop in bursts.

Jamal Ortiz: initiating token rotation. steps: 
1) create new token with reduced scope: `redwood tokens create --owner BlueTrack --scopes=generate:limited,embeddings:read --expires=30d`
2) update partner config (Sara will push)
3) revoke old token via `redwood tokens revoke tok_3fA9...`

Sara Chen: drafting short note for BlueTrack: "We've detected unusual reuse of your service token. We'll provision a new token with limited scopes and a 30d TTL. Please rotate to the new token within 10 minutes of receiving it. Temporary degraded throughput expected during rotation." sending draft to #partners for approval.

Eli Novak: quick check — any logs forwarded to external indexers (ELK/Splunk) that might have the token in plaintext? Jamal?

Jamal Ortiz: yes, there are entries in a staging log-forwarder to splunk-staging. I'm running a scrub to confirm token exposure.

sec-bot: if token found in external logs, escalate to Legal/Security for disclosure. Also start KMS rotation checklist if required.

Jamal Ortiz: scrub results: test tokens were present in splunk-staging indexes between 2026-02-10 and 2026-02-11. Primary token was not found in public/third-party indexes. Looks like test tokens slipped.

Sara Chen: okay — primary token likely compromised via replay rather than raw exfil. Still rotate primary asap. Jamal, revoke test tokens and purge from splunk-staging (requesting retention purge now).

Jamal Ortiz: revocation complete for test tokens. Purge request filed: ticket INF-1229. ETA for purge: 3h.

Ops Oncall: new token created and secrets pushed to internal secret store. Applying immediate swap on edge proxies to accept new token for BlueTrack traffic only. Rolling swap in 2 waves to limit disruption.

deploy-bot: swap job started: proxy-swap-bluetrack-wave1 (5% of edges).

Sara Chen: sent partner rotation email with new token & rollout instructions. asked them to pause any automated replays.

Eli Novak: monitoring session reuse metric. still seeing a small number of replays but falling. Could be delayed retries from partner CI.

Ops Oncall: wave1 5% swap healthy. wave2 100% scheduled in 90s.

Jamal Ortiz: after revoke, tok_3fA9... is rejected across all endpoints. Confirming zero successful requests using old token in last 10m.

Sara Chen: partner acknowledged and confirmed they've paused CI and will rotate on their side. Preparing customer impact note for CS: likely impact window ~5-10m for BlueTrack integrations, no other customers affected.

Eli Novak: continuing observation for 30m. collecting metrics and will surface if any anomalies return.

deploy-bot: incident P1-3075 status update: contained. WAF blocks applied, primary token rotated, test tokens revoked, external logs purge requested.

Sara Chen: good work team. we'll schedule a postmortem tomorrow and include remediation: stricter token TTLs, automated leakage scans for logs, partner onboarding checklist update. tagging @Security and @Legal for follow-up.

Ops Oncall: handing back to normal oncall. leaving monitoring hooks and pager rule relaxed in 1h if stable.

Jamal Ortiz: logging final artifacts and saving runbook steps to https://internal.redwood/incidents/3075002222.

Sara Chen: closing thread after 1hr stable and purge verification. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
